outcome: Composite outcome of in-hospital death and respiratory support
Requirement for mechanical or non-mechanical respiratory support
cohort: Adult patients (aged >= 18 years) who were hospitalized for COVID-19 at Michigan Medicine from February 1, 2020, to October 30, 2022, including pregnant and non-pregnant females.
finding: Pregnant women hospitalized for COVID-19 were more likely to require respiratory support and had higher rates of preterm birth and neonatal intensive care unit admission for their infants compared to non-pregnant hospitalized women.
mod_finding: Among pregnant women hospitalized for COVID-19 who delivered during their hospitalization, 75% (12/16) required a cesarean section.
gest_age: Gestational age at hospitalization (categorized as <= 27 weeks or > 27 weeks) and at birth (< 37 weeks for preterm).
